lastCompletedStory.title: Migrate check-all.ts gate-runner spawn seam to Bun.spawnSync

nextStoryContext: US-001 (this story) migrated ONLY scripts/check-all.ts's exported SpawnFn seam (return type from node's SpawnSyncReturns<string> to Bun's SyncSubprocess<'inherit','inherit'>, default impl now Bun.spawnSync([cmd, ...args], { cwd, stdin: 'inherit', stdout: 'inherit', stderr: 'inherit' }), verdict mapping now `result.success && result.exitCode === 0`). US-002 is a separate, non-exported-type migration for check-coverage.ts/validate-agents-md.ts's 3 internal spawn call sites -- different gotchas apply there (stdout/stderr are Buffer|undefined needing explicit decode, check-ignore maps EXIT CODE not stdout, no `.error` equivalent so fail-closed via throwing on !success). Do not conflate the two stories' spawn-seam shapes.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs state success=true iff exitCode===0 but don't clarify exitCode's runtime value on signal-termination; live-verified with a real SIGTERM child (Bun.spawnSync(['bash','-c','kill -TERM $$'])) that exitCode is actually null at runtime despite the .d.ts declaring `exitCode: number` -- verdict mapping written defensively as `result.success && result.exitCode === 0` rather than relying on the (misleadingly non-nullable) type alone.
